newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Aluar still undecided on expansion.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Aluar still undecided on expansion.

text.p: Argentine aluminum refiner Aluar will continue to study whether to go ahead with a big expansion next year, the firm's president wrote in a newspaper supplement Tuesday.
"During 1997, the company will continue evaluating the project to expand output capacity by 40 percent," Dolores Quintanilla de Madanes wrote in the El Cronista supplement.
Aluar's administration manager Gregorio Krauchik told Reuters in September he expected a decision on the $280 million expansion by October.

Aluar's 1996 output will be around 186,500 tonnes of aluminum, Quintanilla de Madanes said. Some 56,000 tonnes of this output will supply the Argentine market, up seven percent from 1995, but exports will fall slightly, she said.
